summary: IDS feed s077_single is degraded due to tool overload: 3.05 Gbps micro-bursts exceed the 1 Gbps IDS port by 305% (3 overloaded intervals). All other checks (duplicates, encrypted_share, missing_vlan, one_way, packet_drops) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding aggregated/bursty traffic peaking at 3.05 Gbps in 1ms bursts directly to a single 1 Gbps IDS port with no load balancing or shaping, exceeding port capacity by 305% and crossing the 80% (0.8 Gbps) overload threshold in 3 intervals.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS will suffer buffer overruns and random packet drops during bursts, breaking TCP reassembly and bidirectional flow tracking. With needs_both_directions=true and needs_full_payload=true, this causes missed signatures, false negatives, and severely degraded detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute bursts across multiple IDS ports/instances with bidirectional 5-tuple hashing to keep each 1 Gbps port under 80% utilization while preserving both directions and full payload required for IDS detection.
